story.title: MeitY Tightens AI Labelling Rules for India, Mandates Continuous Disclosure of AI-Generated Content
story.summary: India's Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) has issued updated regulations requiring platforms to apply continuous disclosure labels to AI-generated content, going beyond one-time labelling at upload. The new rules tighten accountability for platforms hosting synthetic media and are part of India's broader push to regulate AI outputs in public-facing digital spaces. This move follows growing global concern around AI-generated misinformation and deepfakes circulating on Indian social media platforms.
